basis: Total assets as IAS 1 requires the statement of financial position to present it.
caveat: Recognition differs even where the totals are named alike: development costs are capitalised under IAS 38 and generally expensed under ASC 730, and LIFO is permitted under US GAAP and prohibited by IAS 2.

basis: Total assets as ASC 210 presents it.
caveat: See the caveat on the IFRS row of this measure.

basis: Cash and cash equivalents as IAS 7 defines them.
caveat: Not directly comparable to the US total: ASU 2016-18 requires restricted cash and restricted cash equivalents in the cash flow statement total, and IAS 7 does not.

basis: Cash and cash equivalents excluding restricted amounts; the closer match to IAS 7.
caveat: Excludes restricted cash that the cash flow statement total includes.

basis: The total the cash flow statement reconciles to under ASU 2016-18.
caveat: Includes restricted cash and so overstates the IAS 7 measure.

basis: Total equity including non-controlling interests as IAS 1 presents it.
Total equity including non-controlling interests, which is what ifrs-full:Equity means.
Equity attributable to the parent.
caveat: Excludes non-controlling interests and is therefore NOT the counterpart of ifrs-full:Equity; it corresponds to ifrs-full:EquityAttributableToOwnersOfParent. It is second here because many filings tag no total including NCI, not because it is equivalent.

basis: Equity attributable to the owners of the parent.
Equity attributable to the parent; the counterpart of the IFRS element.
Total liabilities as IAS 1 presents it.
Total liabilities as ASC 210 presents it.
caveat: Many filings with the Commission tag no total liabilities at all, presenting only liabilities and equity together, so this measure is absent for a substantial part of the US population rather than zero.

basis: Profit or loss including non-controlling interests as IAS 1 presents it.
Net income including non-controlling interests, which is what ifrs-full:ProfitLoss means.
Net income attributable to the parent.
caveat: Excludes non-controlling interests and is therefore NOT the counterpart of ifrs-full:ProfitLoss; it corresponds to ifrs-full:ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent. It is second here because many filings tag no total including NCI.

basis: Profit or loss attributable to the owners of the parent.
Net income attributable to the parent; the counterpart of the IFRS element.
Revenue as IAS 1 requires it to be presented.
caveat: Broader than the US element: ifrs-full:Revenue may include revenue from sources other than contracts with customers, which ASC 606 reports separately.

basis: Revenue from contracts with customers under IFRS 15; the exact counterpart of the ASC 606 element.
caveat: Excludes revenue outside IFRS 15 that the total may include.

basis: Revenue from contracts with customers under ASC 606; IFRS 15 and ASC 606 are substantially converged.
caveat: The excluding and including assessed tax split has no IFRS counterpart; a filer choosing the including variant is reporting a larger figure than an IFRS filer would.

basis: The same revenue with assessed taxes included where the filer tags only this one.
caveat: Larger than the IFRS measure by the assessed taxes it includes.

basis: Total revenues where the filer tags no ASC 606 element.
caveat: Predates ASC 606 and is tagged inconsistently; it is the last resort and not an equivalent of the IFRS total.
